    Forbidden configurations in faithful supports #

    def:faithful-support with Lemma 8.8: if finitely many rays from x (or into x) have a factorization order isomorphic to a table poset that passes the decide checks of FinPoset (unique lower covers and the dimension count), finite representation type is contradicted. The axioms of the table poset follow from those of the factorization order.
